answer: Proof-of-stake serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism by requiring agents to lock capital as a pearl of value to participate in consensus. Any attempt to whisper false identities into the network is filtered through a cryptographic prism, ensuring only validators with locked assets can propose blocks. An attacker must incur the immense cost of acquiring significant network tokens, making the creation of multiple fake identities economically prohibitive rather than computationally trivial.
